svg.text: Folding concept 1: geared single-pivot swing wing
Swift outline A, 400 mm foam build, top view, nose up. Printed at 100 % this sheet is half size.
span 400 mm, length nose to tail end 144 mm; dashed purple = fold lines; amber dashed = path of the tip
orange dots = pivot pins; green dot (folded view) = hook
orange dots = pivot pins; amber dashed = path of the tip from open to folded
stowed span 92 mm, length 259 mm (nose to tips); tips 114 mm past the tail
pink = left and right wing overlap (5237 mm2): one wing must sit a layer above the other
50 mm of the glider, drawn at 1:2 (scale bar 25 mm long); the 400 mm span is drawn 200 mm wide. Stowed states at 1:1 on the last page.
